newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-EFFENBERG APPEALS AGAINST FINE FOR ASSAULT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EFFENBERG APPEALS AGAINST FINE FOR ASSAULT.

text.p: Borussia Moenchengladbach's controversial captain Stefan Effenberg has lodged an appeal against a fine imposed on him and his wife for assault, a German court spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
Earlier this month a court ordered former German international Effenberg and his wife Martina to pay 390,000 marks ($215,000) for the alleged attack on a 57-year-old metalworker last December.
The couple had denied the accusations that they had kicked and insulted the man outside their home.

Effenberg's career has been packed with controversy. The midfielder was sent home from the 1994 World Cup finals in the United States after making an obscene gesture at German fans during a match. He has not played for his country since.
The spokeswoman said Effenberg's appeal would probably be heard in September.
